acceptance_evidence.evidence: ReqwestCloudApi::new configures the strict client with no_proxy(), and ambient_proxy_does_not_intercept_loopback_mint runs a child with every HTTP/HTTPS/all proxy variable pointed at a live proxy while the authenticated literal-loopback mint reaches only its origin. The known-default loopback endpoint behavior is supplied by staged dependency baseline commit 00a030b2, which is not part of this worker patch.

valid_cross_authority_redirect_is_rejected_without_target_contact serves a syntactically valid Location on the origin, asserts the origin received the one exact bearer, expects ResponseRejected, and proves a live second listener receives no connection. The client retains Policy::none and performs no redirect request.

The explicitly named REALTIME_TICKET_RESPONSE_BODY_MAX_BYTES response cap is applied to Content-Length preflight and cumulative streamed chunks. realtime_http.rs covers oversized Content-Length, exact 8192-byte chunked acceptance, and 8193-byte chunked rejection with InvalidResponse, alongside malformed response rejection.

Header parsing by field name requires exactly one Authorization value equal to Bearer access-secret. Grant Debug includes [REDACTED] while excluding both access-secret and the distinct serialized ticket; mismatch error Debug/Display similarly exclude the distinct ticket and access token.

Production mint_realtime samples unix_now() only after bounded response receipt, strict decode, and correlation, so the delayed server-issued exact-TTL integration case succeeds. The private grant_from_response seam has fixed-time tests for expired, exact REALTIME_TICKET_TTL_MS, and excessive TTL boundaries without exposing a caller-controlled production clock.
